method.capture: tests/visual/capture-public.spec.js and capture-admin.spec.js (shared session: capture-session.mjs), run with tests/visual/visual.config.js (the browser suite's servers and Chromium)
method.viewports: viewport size only (Desktop Chrome device: no mobile user agent or touch emulation); a reached state is resized and its colour scheme emulated in place, except the start-up states, which load once per viewport and scheme
method.observation: tests/visual/observe-init.js records the page's waiting indicators on every DOM change; each step lists the distinct states seen while it ran
